description: We are a multidisciplinary team passionate about AI, software, data, and space exploration. For NASA Space Apps, we are developing a geospatial solution to identify Earth locations similar to locations on the Moon and Mars. Our project combines AI, geospatial data, backend, frontend, and interactive visualization.
summary:
**TERRA TWIN** is an interactive 3D platform that identifies the top five locations on Earth that most closely resemble selected regions on the Moon and Mars.

The platform uses real satellite data to analyze and compare environmental and geological characteristics across Earth, the Moon, and Mars. It ranks the five most suitable Earth locations based on their similarity scores, showing users how closely each location matches the selected extraterrestrial region.

Through interactive 3D models, visual comparisons, and real imagery from Earth and planetary surfaces, users can explore these locations, examine their similarities, and better understand the environments that could support future space exploration.

TERRA TWIN aims to bridge the gap between Earth observation and planetary exploration by making scientific data more accessible and helping researchers, space agencies, and future astronauts identify Earth-based analog sites for mission preparation and habitat research.
details:
TERRA TWIN is an interactive 3D web platform designed to identify the five locations on Earth that most closely resemble a selected region on the Moon or Mars. Its main goal is to discover Earth-based environments that could serve as analog sites for studying and preparing for future human missions beyond Earth.

The platform uses real satellite data and scientific resources to analyze and compare environmental and geological characteristics. Based on the analysis, it identifies and ranks the top five matching locations on Earth, displaying a similarity percentage for each location.

Users can explore interactive 3D models, navigate between planetary environments, and view visual comparisons using real imagery of locations on Earth, the Moon, and Mars.

What are its benefits and expected impact?

  • Helps researchers identify Earth locations that resemble lunar and Martian environments.
  • Supports astronaut training and preparation for future space missions.
  • Provides a visual and interactive way to understand complex scientific and geographical data.
  • Contributes to research on potential locations for future human habitats beyond Earth.
  • Makes planetary exploration data more accessible and understandable to a wider audience.

What tools and technologies were used?

We combined modern web development technologies with scientific data and 3D visualization techniques to build the platform, including:

  • React for developing the interactive frontend.
  • 3D Models to create immersive planetary exploration experiences.
  • Satellite Data and Real Imagery to support location analysis and visual comparisons.
  • Data Visualization Techniques to present analysis results and similarity scores.

What makes the project creative and innovative?

The innovative aspect of TERRA TWIN is transforming planetary environment comparison from static scientific data and images into an interactive 3D experience.

Instead of manually searching for similar environments, users can explore a platform that analyzes available data, identifies the five closest matching locations on Earth, and displays their similarity scores compared to a selected region on the Moon or Mars.

By bringing Earth observation and planetary exploration together in one interactive experience, TERRA TWIN creates a new way to visualize and understand the similarities between these three worlds.

What factors did the team consider?

Our team focused on data accuracy, reliable scientific sources, meaningful environmental comparisons, and clear similarity results. We also considered usability, accessibility, and smooth interaction with 3D models to ensure that complex scientific information could be explored through an engaging and understandable experience.
